"''I...don't!|The droid and clone trooper Hevy|}} A '''B1-series battle droid''' took part in the [[Defense of Rishi Station]], where he was part of a reinforcement squadron sent to [[Rishi Station]] after the team of [[BX-series droid commando]]s sent there was destroyed. During the skirmish, the droids managed to drive of the remaining squadron of [[clone trooper]]s stationed there, with the exception of [[Hevy]]. After a brief firefight, the clone was overpowered by the droids. However, Hevy managed to set off a tibanna bomb, killing himself and destroying the listening post. All the battle droids, including this one, were destroyed in the ensuing explosion. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]]
